description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340016568270 BRACKET,ANGLE: Line 0001 Qty 30 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0111 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
